Name: Anglie's Anime Portrait and Sprite Mod
Author: AngelieViolet
Description:
[b][color=#9fc5e8][u]***UPDATE OCT 29[/u]: Caroline, Pierre, Jodi, Kent, Sandy, and Willy have been added! New alternates for Sam, Vincent, and Alex. Please redownload Marnie's sprite, one of her animations was wonky. Also, take a look at the poll I added [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/velverettes-anime-portrait-sprite-mod-update-10-29.115906/]here[/url]
ONE MORE THING in case you missed it, I also added a file with the cursors.xnb sprites if you want to go grab that [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img][/color][/b]

This was originally meant for my personal use but I decided to share it! I just wanted different hairstyles for the villagers so I went and made my own portraits.
These were made to suit my very specific tastes, and as such most of them don't look like the source material so I understand they're not for everybody, but I hope you like it! Also yes, I do intend to do most if not all villagers, but it takes time so please be patient!

[b]EXTRAS:
[/b][list]
[*]Alternate colors to mix and match
[*]No glasses options for both Maru and Harvey
[*]A Jas portrait and sprite option that is compatible with randomanon123's [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/587/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D587%26preview%3D&pUp=1]character development mod[/url][/b]
[*]Cursors.xnb and .png files for the extra sprites.
[/list]
